c: What do you want to do?
Tidy up my library
Fix song texts, set aside duplicates, broken songs and leftover files, and even out the volume. You choose what on the next page.
Add new songs to my library
Bring songs from other folders into the library. Songs it already has are compared, and only the best version is kept.
See what is in my library
Count the songs, see how they are spread over the folders, how many have a video or a picture, and how much is set aside.
Free up space from audio backups
Evening out the volume keeps a copy of every changed audio file. Look at how much space they take, and delete them once you are happy with the result.
Read the reports of earlier runs
Open the lists the tools wrote: what was planned or moved, songs with encoding problems, missing files and check results.
Put back set-aside songs
Look at the duplicates, broken songs, removed songs and leftover files that were set aside, and put back the ones you want to keep.
Check my songs for problems
Find songs that cannot be played or have problems, such as missing audio, damaged files or notes that do not fit the music. Nothing is changed.
Remove songs from my library
Set aside every song of the artists or songs you name. Nothing is deleted: the songs are moved out of the library and can be put back.
Build a new library from folders
Sort songs from one or more folders into a new library with a folder per first letter (A to Z, 0-9 and #).
Your library
Browse…
The folder that holds your songs. What is set aside is moved out of it; the songs you keep stay where they are.
